from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p):
    k,p1,c0,q,cc,F,w,ph,b=p
    return -k*np.sign(x)*np.abs(x)**p1 - c0*np.sign(v)*np.abs(v)**q - cc*v + F*np.cos(w*t+ph)+b
